items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The one, they had a boy they called Cook Shop Son.

ctx.x: Uh. No. Not little Mac Lacey. No. My little Mac Lacey. No.
Now there was one drummer that, that, that he used it most of the time. I think it was, he used this drummer more than he did any of them. The one, they had a boy they called Cook Shop Son.
